lineage: Descendant execution/measurement audit of sealed drawdown_conditions; no new strategy candidates, no retuning.
hypotheses: Historical bar-close observability differs from explicit source publication metadata; audit semantics rather than rewrite source fields.
One-minute later execution may alter losses and apparent conditional risk progress even with identical signals.

Slow-conflict reductions can miss profitable countertrend trades or restore full exposure before losses; exact signed opportunity and cost accounting can explain observed counterexamples without declaring structural causality.
Minute source repair may create nonobserved execution prices; separately count and skip synthetic fill events.
diagnostic_comparator: Retrospective constant matched to slow_conflict_half mean time exposure, separately per view/scenario/evaluation year; no deployable claim.

execution_scenarios.legacy_on_minute: Same next-five-minute-view open schedule as predecessor, located by source 1m open at close_label-1m. Minute marks expose intra-bar drawdowns. Starting account flat at first scored five-minute open. Final liquidation at last scored five-minute open in2025.
execution_scenarios.delay_1m: Same frozen schedule, but execute at first 1m open whose inferred start is at least one wall-clock minute later. Signal formula unchanged.
execution_scenarios.delay_1m_observed: delay_1m plus skip minute rows with source_kind containing causal_flat_missing_minute for fill events; preserve original mark series.
execution_scenarios.literal_publication: Release each completed signal no earlier than its original timezone-aware available_at and its close time, interpreted as Shanghai wall-clock. At each scheduled five-minute open use latest released signal only; no intraday values before15:30. Latest batch wins; diagnostic of literal metadata, not an assertion about true vendor latency.

account: log_index q_before*log(Pnext/Pprev) less -log(1-c_bps*abs(delta_q)/10000). Complete orders, entry, resize, reversal and final exit. Same minute endpoints within each view. Also preserve legacy five-minute sampled metrics as separate comparator.
review: One-year preparation per command; main agent writes graphical/event interpretation and seals digest chain before next year. All policies are frozen predecessor policies; no blind/family candidate ranking and no new family to open. All years already consumed.

attribution.condition_cells: Lag source slow_conflict/chop and signal to each executed position; disjoint none/chop_only/slow_only/both.
attribution.opportunity: Hindsight signed positive/negative gross contribution removed by half exposure; exact gross delta and cost savings vs baseline and same-exposure constant. Hindsight labels have no runtime authority.
attribution.counterexamples: Top10 DD decline/recovery windows per baseline primary view/scenario/cost, plus annual and view4 deltas; report calendar labels only as diagnostic indices.
attribution.latency: Sum portfolio holding-difference times identical minute log-return; no aggregate-MDD additive causal claim.
attribution.source_audit: Exact existing 5m open and close to 1m endpoint lookup, available_at parse with offsets retained, synthetic marks by clock/year, no local resampling or substitute fills.

primary_objective: Establish whether predecessor risk improvement survives realistic delay assumptions; MDD reduction is retained conditionally, return sacrifice allowed, no hidden choice of best scenario.
promotion: No promotion while source availability semantics or tradable instrument mapping unresolved. No newly validated causal efficacy even if synthetic execution prefix tests pass.
source_access: Only this repository and its exact previously exported 2020-2025 carriers, hashes checked against sealed input receipt. No other FactorLab repository.
